registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Host control register. Writing this register updates host-visible enable and clear-fault control fields and may also be used as a configuration-strobe trigger when combined with the configuration window.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Controller enable. Maps to host_cfg_enable. When 0, the controller enters safe fallback mode and act_valid is deasserted.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULT
fields.description: Host clear-fault request. Clears sticky_fault only when no active fault condition persists.

registers.name: MODE
registers.description: Operating mode selection register. Two-bit mode value used both for request packing and host-visible control state.

fields.name: MODE_SEL
fields.description: Operating mode select. Maps to host_cfg_mode and current_mode reporting.
